import importlib.metadata as m,json,platform
import torch,torchvision
d=m.distribution('fedops')
u=json.loads(d.read_text('direct_url.json'))
assert d.version=='1.1.30.19+onprem.20260916'
assert u['url']=='https://github.com/minsoojo/fedops-core-onprem.git'
assert u['vcs_info']['commit_id']=='ff5f44ddea2705c8d901a54a0272f517822da8f4'
assert u['subdirectory']=='src/python'
assert m.version('fedops-federated-task')=='0.19.1'
assert torch.__version__=='2.8.0+cpu' and torchvision.__version__=='0.23.0+cpu'
assert torchvision.ops.nms(torch.tensor([[0.,0.,1.,1.]]),torch.tensor([1.]),0.5).tolist()==[0]
print(json.dumps(dict(python=platform.python_version(),platform=platform.platform(),fedops=d.version,direct_url=u,torch=torch.__version__,torchvision=torchvision.__version__,torchvision_nms='passed')))
